SERVICES / FOUNDER-LED

Brand Identity & Graphic Design Services

A consistent visual system and usable assets, scoped around your audience and day-to-day needs.

Who this is for

Small businesses and agencies that need a coherent identity or a defined set of graphic assets for a website, presentation or campaign.

Deliverables

Agree visual direction, logo refinement or development, colour and typography guidance, usage rules, named templates, export formats and editable source files. The asset list and revision rounds define the project.

Exclusions

Brand research beyond the agreed brief, naming, trademark clearance, photography, illustration commissions, printing and unlimited revisions are separate. Font and image licences must be confirmed for the intended use.

Process

Understand the audience → approve a direction → review concepts → refine the selected direction → approve named assets → deliver files and usage guidance.

Commercial approach

Request a tailored quote around the asset list and approval rounds. Additional formats and ongoing design support are separately scoped.

Relevant evidence

The retail concept and architecture concept demonstrate different palette, typography and layout treatments. They are fictional website identities, not commissioned branding programmes.

Useful preparation

The scope guide helps assign content and asset ownership. The cost guide separates project work from recurring licences.

Discuss your project.

Bring your current website, audience, priorities and any constraints. We’ll use the discovery call to decide whether the work is a good fit, then agree a written scope.
